projectDescription: TailorKit is a hosted framework that lets SaaS products embed a sandboxed app ecosystem, enabling users, partners, and AI to build extensions using the host product's own components, data, and actions.
keyFeatures: Sandboxed opaque-origin iframe runtime for safe execution of third-party and AI-generated extension code
Host-controlled component contract — apps render through named host components, never raw DOM
Typed schema system (Zod, Valibot, ArkType) for views, slots, contexts, actions, and components
Server-side actions — trusted server functions TailorKit apps can call
CLI for scaffolding, generating host bindings, previewing, and deploying apps
React adapter with AppView, useApps, useView, and Root for host-side rendering
Layout primitives (Box, Flex, Grid, Inline) with responsive theme tokens
Named scopes for per-user and per-organization app installation boundaries
Managed CDN infrastructure for app asset delivery
Framework-agnostic handler — supports Next.js, TanStack Start, React Router, Nitro, Hono, and any standard Request/Response backend
publicApiSurface: Root, AppView, useApps, useView, primitives — tailorkit/react
